explication: html-to-markdown converts parsed HTML into Markdown through a configurable Go converter, with a library wrapper and a CLI path for input selection, optional plugins, and output. The core stages are parsing/filtering, plugin-driven rendering, and output formatting; shared collapse and escaping utilities support rendering. The README also describes custom tag renderers, CommonMark options, strikethrough, and tables. Edges reflect the supplied excerpts or explicit README usage; unsampled CLI I/O and converter internals are not expanded into guessed calls.
